BUILD IN THE OPEN

Protocol docs.

Architecture, launch lifecycle, fees and security principles.

01 · Getting started

Connect an EVM wallet, choose a configured network and explore verified launches. Only supported EVM wallets are used.

02 · Launch lifecycle

Token creation, bonding curve trading, on-chain graduation verification and liquidity migration.

03 · Multichain

Reusable EVM factory architecture across four configured EVM networks.

04 · Fees & rewards

Launch fee is an immutable factory parameter awaiting approval; curve trades currently pay 0.5%; graduation is triggered at a $20,000 FDV. No separate graduation fee is configured.

05 · Security

Audits, access controls, oracle safety, slippage limits, pause controls and recoverable migration.

06 · Asset pairs

Future support for pairing UNIRAE launches with issuer-authorized tokenized equities through audited token-to-token liquidity routes. No synthetic shares or shareholder rights are implied.

Admin access is not authenticated in this standalone preview. No real financial data or withdrawal controls are exposed.

03 · CREATOR ECONOMICSConfigure how your token operates

Creator tax settings

Set optional token taxes. Buy/sell tax applies to a future configured AMM pool after graduation; bonding-curve trades use the separate 0.5% protocol fee. Transfer tax applies to regular wallet transfers.

Each tax is creator-configured and capped at 10%. The bonding curve is permanently tax-exempt so curve reserves remain exact. The creator can later change taxes, pair flags and ownership; these controls must be disclosed to buyers.
This split applies to token transfer-tax proceeds. Native bonding-curve trade fees use the separately configured platform fee vault.
Token transfer-tax buyback remains locked at 0%. Native curve buyback is a separate platform-configured fee-vault allocation.
Share of token-tax proceeds assigned to token burns.
Allocation total: 100%
Launch fee: $5 USD equivalent on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain and X Layer, calculated in native coin using the chain's verified USD oracle. Developer exemption: only the fixed UNIRAE developer wallets launch free; all other users pay the listed fee. Trading fees and taxes still apply to developer launches.
Platform wallet (EVM): 0xB6Cb72B580555EB27cf96504C3Ef89DaD1D2DA32
Token-tax routing: 10% of collected token tax is routed directly to the platform wallet; the remaining 90% follows the creator/burn allocation. This split is shown in the contract and cannot be changed by creators.
V2.22 EVM integration: EVM wallet connection and network switching are enabled. Native curve fees can be split to creator claims, platform claims and a thresholded buyback vault when configured on the deployed factory. Token + bonding-curve factory deployment is conditional on a verified factory address, configured Chainlink feed and approved launch fee. The market adapter supports on-chain quotes and trades once a verified market is selected. Automatic DEX liquidity migration remains gated on verified deployment configuration.
